system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Athletics and Intimidation, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Arena Fighting Lore, Prizefights Lore, Lore of a fighting circuit.
system.description: You fought for purses, wagers, or someone else’s profit. You learned how to frighten an opponent before the first exchange and how to keep standing when the crowd demanded more.
